summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing a nonbinding LOI with institutional holders to exchange part of a Senior Secured Convertible Promissory Note due 2028 for convertible preferred stock and waive token rights, aimed at curing a Nasdaq minimum stockholders' equity deficiency under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1). Definitive agreements are pending; terms unspecified. This is a balance-sheet restructuring to regain listing compliance, not a standard corporate event. Watch for final exchange terms and Nasdaq compliance timeline, though no premium or price is stated.
